name: TrustGate AI
description: A read-only, fail-closed Concordium agent badge verifier and deterministic payment-intent policy prototype. Reviews agent identity, recipient allowlist and per-request limits to produce ALLOW, REVIEW or BLOCK. ALLOW is NOT a transfer authorization; no wallet signing, payments, or x402 settlement is executed.

extensions.description: Verified by Concordium badge — CIS-8004 on-chain identity (card integrity pending anchor)

params.verify: Resolve tokenAddress via CIS-8004 agent_of; require status Active and card SHA-256 equal to on-chain metadata_hash.

skills.name: Verify Concordium agent identity
skills.description: Checks an agent badge against Concordium registry verification results. Fail closed when registry or card-hash attestation is unavailable.

skills.name: Review payment intent
skills.description: Deterministically classifies a proposed service payment as ALLOW, REVIEW or BLOCK without executing payment or modifying wallet balances.
